entities.name: Sianna
entities.description: Farrelite of Montford, once Oliver Farrel's concubine and then his champion, killed in the battle with the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: Followers of Oliver Farrel whose fanaticism escalated after his and Sianna's deaths.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: Leader of the Farrelites who proclaimed Tymolin the living incarnation of Tourach.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Declared the living incarnation of Tourach by Farrel; captured by Vaylesh.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: Tymolin's brother, an extremely powerful planeswalker who transformed into Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Ian
entities.description: Sianna's friend, to whom she confided doubts.

entities.name: Vaylesh
entities.description: Captured Tymolin with the Order of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: Where Tev and Tymolin became separated.

events.summary: Sianna, once a concubine, becomes Oliver Farrel's champion and is given his mantle; her first charge is to slay Tymolin Loneglade.
events.quote: Originally a concubine of Oliver Farrel , Sianna eventually became his champion

events.summary: The Farrelites ambush Tymolin and Tev; Tev defends her from an aeolipile and disenchants the mantle from Sianna, sending the Farrelites into retreat.
events.quote: Tev then disenchanted the mantle from Sianna, sending the Farrelites into retreat.

events.summary: Tymolin is captured by Vaylesh and the Order of the Ebon Hand after being separated from Tev.
events.quote: Tymolin was captured by Vaylesh and the Order of the Ebon Hand

events.summary: At the Ebon Hand encampment Farrel offers Tymolin Sianna's place; she refuses and he strikes her down with a dagger, sparking combat.
events.quote: Tymolin refused, and Farrel struck her down with a dagger

events.summary: Tev, transformed into Tevesh Szat, kills everyone present with a Fireball, including Sianna and Oliver.
events.quote: he killed everyone present with a mighty Fireball

relations.quote: was a member of the Farrelites on Dominaria
Tymolin and her brother, Tev Loneglade
